title: goniopteris retroflexa
intro: Goniopteris retroflexa, commonly known as the False Holly Fern, is a species of fern native to the tropical and subtropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, boasting health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Goniopteris retroflexa include its ability to treat digestive problems, skin conditions, and respiratory issues, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
